home.title: Ask about Naija laws.
home.intro: Ask am as you take talk am. You go get answer wey clear, plus di exact sections wey e come from.
home.paused: Explanations don pause small. Find section make you continue to read di laws wey dem publish.
suggestions: How long police fit hold me before dem carry me go court?
home.disclaimer: Di answers dey explain di published laws for simple language, and dem fit miss some details. Check di sections wey dem link, and talk to lawyer about your own matter.

outcome.noSection: We no find any published section wey answer dis. Ask am another way, or name di law and di section.
outcome.unfinished: We no fit finish dis answer. Na di sections wey concern am be dis.
